text.ms:
1. (1) Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Keselamatan Sosial Pekerjaan Sendiri (Kadar Caruman bagi Pemandu Bas) 2019.

(2) Peraturan-Peraturan ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 Februari 2019.

Tafsiran

2. Dalam Peraturan-Peraturan ini, "pemandu bas" ertinya mana-mana orang bekerja

sendiri yang —

(a) menjalankan aktiviti pekerjaan sendiri sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam

butiran 1 Jadual Pertama kepada Akta;

(b) mempunyai lesen memandu yang sah yang dikeluarkan di bawah seksyen 26

Akta Pengangkutan Jalan 1987 [Akta 333]; dan

(c) bagi maksud perenggan (a), telah dikeluarkan baginya suatu lesen

vokasional yang sah di bawah seksyen 56 Akta Pengangkutan Jalan 1987 oleh

Pengarah bagi Pengangkutan Jalan.

Kadar caruman

3. (1) Tiap-tiap pemandu bas hendaklah membayar suatu caruman kepada

Pertubuhan atau mana-mana ejen keselamatan sosial pekerjaan sendiri pada kadar

sebagaimana yang dipilih oleh pemandu bas itu berdasarkan Pendapatan Bulanan Pilihan

yang Diinsuranskan sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

(2) Tempoh pelindungan bagi kadar caruman yang dipilih oleh pemandu bas

di bawah subperaturan (1) hendaklah bagi tempoh dua belas bulan berturut-turut.

(3) Jika dalam tempoh pelindungan yang disebut dalam subperaturan (2)

kesahan lesen vokasional yang dikeluarkan kepada pemandu bas di bawah seksyen 56

Akta Pengangkutan Jalan 1987 habis tempoh—

(a) tempoh pelindungan itu hendaklah terus berkuat kuasa sehingga

tempoh dua belas bulan berturut-turut itu habis; dan

(b) pemandu bas itu hendaklah mengemukakan kepada Pertubuhan,

apabila diminta oleh Pertubuhan, lesen vokasional baharunya untuk

penentusahan.

SELF-EMPLOYMENT SOCIAL SECURITY ACT 2017

 SELF-EMPLOYMENT SOCIAL SECURITY

(RATES OF CONTRIBUTION FOR BUS DRIVER) REGULATIONS 2019

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 10 and paragraph 83(2)(h) of

the Self-Employment Social Security Act 2017 [Act 789], the Minister makes the

following regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Self-Employment Social Security

(Rates of Contribution for Bus Driver) Regulations 2019.

(2) These Regulations come into operation on 1 February 2019.

Interpretation

2. In these Regulations, "bus driver" means any self-employed person who—

(a) carries out the self-employment activity as specified in item 1 of

the First Schedule to the Act;

(b) holds a valid driving licence issued under section 26 of

the Road Transport Act 1987 [Act 333]; and

(c) for the purposes of paragraph (a), has been issued with a valid vocational

licence under section 56 of the Road Transport Act 1987 by a Director for

Road Transport.

Rates of contribution

3. (1) Every bus driver shall pay a contribution to the Organization

or any self-employment social security agent at the rates as selected by the bus driver

based on the Selected Insured Monthly Earning as specified in the Schedule.

(2) The coverage period for the rates of contribution selected by the bus driver

under subregulation (1) shall be for a period of twelve consecutive months.

(3) If within the coverage period referred to in subregulation (2) the

validity of the vocational licence issued to the bus driver under section 56 of the

Road Transport Act 1987 expires—

(a) the coverage period shall continue to have effect until the period of

twelve consecutive months expires; and

(b) the bus driver shall submit to the Organization, upon request by the

Organization, his new vocational licence for verification.
